reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333!

<details>
<summary>Agent review</summary>


Approving as a documentation-only change. I verified the premises rather than taking them from the description:

- `claude-sonnet-4` / `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` were retired on 2026-06-15, and `claude-sonnet-5-5` is the documented replacement. It is in ellmer's Anthropic model registry, which no longer lists Sonnet 4.
- The hand-edited `man/` pages match roxygen2 output exactly. Regenerating the documentation produced no changes beyond a roxygen2 version bump, so nothing was lost by not running roxygen.
- `test-btw_task.R` and `test-btw_client.R` pass. No test or snapshot asserts the changed error message, and the `claude-sonnet-4` strings left in the tests are plain data that still construct without validation.

I pushed one follow-up commit (69668317) covering two spots the sweep didn't reach:

- `R/btw_client.R:61` — the array-format example now shows `aws_bedrock/us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`. The previous id, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0`, is a Bedrock model with an end-of-life of 2026-10-14, so the block read as three current examples while one of them was already unusable. The alias example just below it already used a newer Bedrock id.
- `inst/prompts/btw-init.md:411` — the `btw_task_create_btw_md()` prompt still showed `claude-4-5-sonnet-latest`, which appears in neither ellmer's `claude` nor `anthropic` model list, so `btw.md` front matter generated from that prompt could carry a model id that no longer exists.

That commit also corrects a stale comment in `as_ellmer_client()`, which showed a bare Bedrock model name where the full inference-profile id is required, and tightens the NEWS entry.

The documentation and error-message changes in the original commit were accurate and consistent — thanks for the careful scope notes on the Bedrock ids and the tests, which made this quick to verify.

</details>
